The Otherworld under the hills, a night realm below the bedrock reached by a Bealach frame of reinforced deepslate. Four lands: Tìrdumuind, Koildemaktuldach, Uomunblàtach and Kolbundeilach. Open from Age VI; the sidhe-growth there answers sound, so move quietly.
A frame of reinforced deepslate lit with the Heart of the Deep opens the way. Default doorway is 6 wide and 3 high (config). Age VI.
Taken from the Warden. Use it on a reinforced deepslate frame to light the way into the Otherworld. It beats like a heart while carried.
A staff that throws a sonic blast when charged. Reverberation lengthens the blast and Volume strengthens it. Repaired with a Soul Crystal.
Link it to a container, furnace or workbench, then use it from anywhere to open that block remotely. Dye it with any dye (the link is kept).
Wings of soul. Gliding wings with a booster key; boost cooldown is 600 ticks (30 seconds) by default.
Points at the nearest temple of the old ones while you are in the Otherworld.
Warden armour, upgraded from netherite at a smithing table with a Warden carapace and template. Protects like netherite and looks the part in the Otherworld.
Resonarium armour: sound-bound metal that takes a quarter off incoming damage per piece worn, at the cost of a little durability.
Amber holding a find from the dark: loot, or a sleeping Sùgair. Mine it with silk touch to carry it unbroken.
A many-legged hunter of the Otherworld.
Small and quick, it lurks in amber and in false vases.
A broken thing that walks the lands of the Otherworld in groups of two to five.
Spawns 31% of the time when a false vase is broken, otherwise leeches come.
A biter that can carry up to 8 enchanted books.
A tall worm that cries when it senses you.
16% of vases are false: breaking one wakes leeches or a Lientuir.
Extra damage against creatures of the Otherworld and the Warden.
Where a foe falls, the growth of the Otherworld spreads.
Caverns of glowing bloom and still pools.
Gloom-slate columns under a low ceiling.
